plan.headline: Holiday Monday with a late kicker: Rush at Climate Pledge and the Sex Pistols at Showbox SoDo both let out around 10:45 PM. Work the airport morning and afternoon, then the let-outs at the edges, not the arena curb.

blocks.play: Take Eastside airport requests. After each SEA drop-off, check the line; if it's long, head north to Georgetown or SoDo for Seattle-rate pickups.
Midday on a dry holiday is the weakest window. Rest and eat; tonight runs past midnight.
Take a downtown → SEA trip at the Seattle rate, then a holiday-weekend return pickup at SEA if the line is short. When a trip ends in Seattle, stay there.
Eat and rest in Seattle. Be in position by 10 PM.

Pioneer Square by 10 PM for the Comedy Underground let-out, then a few blocks north of Showbox SoDo for the Sex Pistols crowd around 10:45. Then Belltown, lower Queen Anne and Capitol Hill for Rush fans and late bar trips.
